It's still nowhere near enough...

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for losing my composure... But 
you're right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:

frustrating it is, I have to move forward 
one step at a time.

text_block_list.text:
Alright, first let's review the race... 
Trainer, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Please, be even stricter with 
my training!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“If there's a flame inside me... I have to 
make it burn hotter... even hotter!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's how I'll become stronger than I am 
today. I'll get stronger... and win next 
time!
